targets:

    type: bundle.ui-testing
    platform: iOS

      PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: local.sim.controltests

cat > UITests/ReplyTests.swift <<'EOF'
import XCTest
final class ReplyTests: XCTestCase {
  func testReply() {
    let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
    app.activate()
    let room = app.staticTexts["Book Club"].firstMatch
    XCTAssertTrue(room.waitForExistence(timeout: 10))
    room.tap()
    sleep(3)
    let texts = app.staticTexts
    let msg = texts.matching(NSPredicate(format: "label CONTAINS[c] 'worldbuilding'")).firstMatch
    if msg.waitForExistence(timeout: 5) {
      msg.press(forDuration: 1.2)
    } else {
      let any = texts.element(boundBy: max(0, texts.count - 2)); any.press(forDuration: 1.2)
    }
    sleep(2)
    print("ELEMENTS", app.debugDescription)
  }
}
EOF
